title: General Information (Residence Permit) - Hacettepe
text:
General Information

You can access the guide prepared for the new residence permit procedures **HERE**.

International students studying in Türkiye need to obtain a student residence permit for the duration of their studies. As per the latest decision taken by the Presidency of Migration Management, students will submit their residence permit application documents to the International Students Office.

The brochures titled **"How to Apply for a Student Residence Permit"** prepared by the Ministry of the Interior, Presidency of Migration Management in five languages are available below.

The booklets titled **“Student Residence Permit Application Process”** prepared by the Ministry of the Interior, Presidency of Migration Management in five languages are available below.

**You have seven days from the date you create your application form on the e-ikamet website (https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/) to submit your documents to the International Students Office.** Our office collects all international students' documents and delivers them to the Directorate of Migration Management. To ensure a smooth residence permit application process, it is important that you submit all the required documents to our office in full.

Below you can see the steps of the application process for a student residence permit:

**Step 1:** The application form must be completed online on the Presidency of Migration Management's website (https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/). Please ensure that the information you provide in the application form is accurate.

**Step 2:** You must prepare the other documents mentioned below before visiting our office. Please read carefully to ensure you have everything and that they are prepared appropriately.

**Step 3:** Once you have all the required documents, you must submit them to our office within seven days from the date you create your application form on the e-ikamet website. Our university staff will carefully review your documents, and if everything is complete, they will submit the file to the Provincial Directorate of Migration Management. However, if there are any missing documents, our office will not accept your application, and it will not be processed further. To avoid any delays in your residence permit application, please ensure that you have all the required documents before coming to our office.

**Step 4:** After receiving your residence permit card, you must submit a copy of it to the student affairs office where you are enrolled.

**IMPORTANT NOTES:**

If you suspend your studies, graduate, fail to register for the courses, are dismissed, or withdraw from the University, your student status will become passive. Passive students are not entitled to any student rights. Furthermore, the University will report the status of passive students to the Provincial Directorate of Migration Management, and their student permits will be canceled.

title: Student Visa Application Procedure - Turkish CG Miami
text:
TURKISH CONSULATE GENERAL IN MIAMI

STUDENT VISA APPLICATION PROCEDURE
Foreign nationals intending to pursue studies in Türkiye are required to obtain an education
visa prior to their arrival.

Application Procedure:
1. Assemble the required documents listed below.
2. Start an online application on www.konsolosluk.gov.tr and upload the documents when
prompted.
3. Print out and sign the application form. (Requirement #2)
4. After submitting the application successfully, schedule an appointment for the interview
which will take place at the Consulate.
5. Be present at the Consulate on the day of the interview with the hard copies of all required
documents listed below.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS FOR TOURISM-BUSINESS

1. One fully completed and signed application form (Please bring the visa application form
generated by the system)
2. National passport or official travel document and Copies of the first page.
• Must have at least 6 months of validity remaining.
• with a blank page to affix the visa
3. One recent passport – size (2”x2”) photograph (biometric, white background)
4. Proof of legal status in US (Residency Card, visa, authorization form from USCIS etc.)
• Valid I-20 or the letter from school is required for the student visa holders.
5. Student Certificate and Acceptance Letter from the university at which you wish to
study with the YÖKSİS code.
6. Outbound Flight Reservation (These reservations do not need to be purchased yet)
7. Accommodation Information
• If staying at a commercial facility, a reservation confirmation is required
• If staying at a non-commercial residence, one of the following must be provided:
o signed letter including the address, full name, contact details, and Turkish ID
number of the host
o A letter of undertaking from the host
o A rental agreement for the Property
o Dormatory information.
8. Bank statements of the last 3 months.
• If the applicant covers their own expenses, the account must show at least 50 USD per
day for the planned stay
• If someone else covers the expenses, their bank statement and a letter of financial
guarantee must be provided
9. Proof of International Health insurance
• with a minimum coverage limit of $35,000 for the entire validity of your visa for urgent
medical expenses and/or repatriation due to accident or sudden illness.
• Must cover the entire duration of stay
• International travel health insurance is acceptable
10. Good Conduct Record / Criminal Background Check
• Must be obtained from the FBI
• Records from local police departments or other agencies are not accepted

TURKISH CONSULATE GENERAL IN MIAMI

11. Diploma or Transcript
• A diploma or most recent transcript obtained from the last educational institution
attended.
12. Non-refundable visa fee: CASH ONLY
•
Single Entry: $60.00($185.00 refugee travel document holders/ USA citizens).
•
Multiple Entry: $180.00 ($265.00 refugee travel document holders/ USA citizens).
13. Optional:
A pre-paid envelope (mail carrier of your choice) if you would like your visa-issued passport
to be returned by mail. (Turkish Consulate General in Miami is not responsible for any
delivery issues)

IMPORTANT NOTES:

•
Visa applicants should be resident in our jurisdiction area (Florida, SC, NC, Georgia,
Puerto Rico)
•
Applicants are required to bring hard copies of the documents on the day of the interview.
•
In the event that neither Turkish nor English is spoken, every applicant is required to
arrange for a translator to accompany them to their interview. Failure to do so will
result in rescheduling the appointment with the stipulation that a translator must be
present.
•
Screenshots will not be accepted. Documents are requested in their original size.
•
The documents such as travel insurance, flight and hotel reservations must contain the name
and surname of the applicant/s.
•
In individual cases, the applicant may be required to provide additional documents which
may delay the visa issuance.
•
Turkish Consulate in Miami cannot expedite a visa application.
•
Please do not finalize your travel arrangements until you are notified about the outcome of
your visa application.

For further questions you may contact with us from consulate.miami@mfa.gov.tr

- Common Documents

- Common Documents

- Common Documents

- Common Documents

- Document proving DUS

**Those arriving within the scope of other international exchange programs (1 year)**

**EXPLANATIONS**

- In case students request, valid health insurance shall not be requested as they are covered by general health insurance within three months from the date of registration, but they must notify the administration after taking out general health insurance within three months.
- Upon the request of the administration, e-signed/signed and sealed/stamped student documents to be obtained from the institution where the education is received, or from the e-government system must be submitted.
- If you could not graduate during the normal education period, a residence permit for a maximum of 1 year could be issued at a time for each year upon the submission of a student certificate proving that you could actively benefit from student rights.
- During your residence permit period; in case you continue to study in a different faculty/department of the same university or transfer to a different university in the same province, you must report your situation to the provincial directorate of migration management **within 20 working days** in order to update your information, provided that there is no interruption in your student status.
- If there is a change of university, faculty or department in a different province, you must apply for a residence permit to the provincial directorate of migration management in the province where your new university is located **within 10 days**. All your procedures shall be concluded by the provincial directorate of migration maagement in the province where your new university is located.

- **For children**
- If the mother and father could not be determined from passport or passport substitute document or national identity card, <u>a certified birth certificate</u> shall be requested.
- In the absence of either mother or father, <u>a certified deed of consent</u> shall be requested. (In case of death of one of the parents, the other spouse is required to submit a certified death certificate.)
- In case of divorce, a <u>certified custody</u> document of the child shall be requested.

*(These documents must be e-signed/signed and sealed/stamped if obtained from Turkish authorities; they must have a notarized Turkish translation and an Apostille if obtained from abroad. It is required to be a citizen of a country which is a party to the Apostille Convention; or if there is no Apostille on the document even if the country is a party, the documents in question are required to be approved by the relevant country authoties (approval by the consulate/embassy and Ministry of Foreign Affairs/Turkish Authorities authorized on this issue).*

- If the foreigner in question is under eighteen years old, a certified deed of consent by mother/father abroad or legal representative, and a notarized undertaking by real or legal persons in Turkey, provided that it is specified in the deed of consent, shall be requested. v **For transfer applications**

Photocopy of the previous residence permit document shall be attached to application document. *(The original document shall be submitted to the administration on the appointment day)*

*After all documents are completed, you need to take the documents to the “News from Department of Student Affairs” unit at Ankara University Beşevler 10th Year Campus, Şevket Aziz Kansu Building Floor: 3 Beşevler/Ankara.*

- ***<u>Student document and health insurance document will be given from the Erasmus Office.</u>***

Dear International Students,
All international students studying in Türkiye must have a student residence

title: Health Insurance - Sabancı University
text:
| **Guide for Full Time Students** | Guide for Exchange Students | Guide for Family Members |

#### Health Insurance *- for Full-Time International Students-*

As per immigration laws in Turkey, it is MANDATORY that all students have valid insurance that covers the total duration of their enrollment at Sabancı University. The insurance should take effect from the day the student enters Turkey and cover the complete duration of stay. Health insurance is not only for your own safety, but it is a legal obligation for your stay in Turkey. The health insurance mentioned here must be different from the travel health insurances or that you may have it from your own country. Because in order to obtain a residence permit in Turkey, your insurance has to meet the insurance conditions announced by the immigration office. In addition, the relevant document must be prepared in Turkish in Turkey.

**General Health System in Turkey:**

**🏥 Hospitals:**

First of all, there are two types of hospitals in Turkey: the first one is **private hospitals** and the other is **state hospitals**. Private hospitals provide high level, detailed and personal service according to your needs. Processes are faster but payments are more expensive.

The state hospitals are more preferred because they are cheaper but it can take a long time to get an appointment and you can wait in long lines. You can find good doctors like in private hospitals, but there is not detailed service.

**⚠️ Accepted Health Insurance Options:**

There are two types of health insurance: the first is **private health insurance**. The second is **General Health Insurance - GHI/GSS/SGK** (it has several abbreviations), which is a **state-funded insurance**.

Private health insurances can be used in the private hospitals only and are limited. Their limit decreases in each process that you have at the hospital. It may not cover all costs depending its type. It can be used for processes that meet its benefit table and limits. It may not be used in every hospital because the company to which the private health insurance is affiliated must have an agreement with the relevant hospital. The prices of hospitals you go to (especially Acıbadem, Emsey Hospitals etc.) can be high and they can decrease your insurance limits quickly.

On the other hand, general health insurance is used in state hospitals and the numbers you pay here are very cheap. In addition, general health insurance may or may not be valid in some private hospitals, or its validity can be very low and you may be asked to pay some additional payments there. General Health Insurance allows you to benefit from public hospitals mainly. As Sabancı University full-time international students, you have the right to benefit both of the insurances. The first of these is Aksigorta, which is automatically given by the university after your registration and it is a private health insurance. As university, we provide this private health insurance free for you, but it has limits.

The second is General Health Insurance/GHI/GSS (SGK in Turkish), which is a state-funded health insurance system and provided by the Turkish government as we mentioned above. You have to apply for it after you obtain your residence permit card number.

You will find the details about it below.

**1. Aksigorta (THE INSURANCE PROVIDED BY SABANCI UNIVERSITY)**

• It is a private health insurance provided by Sabancı University for all full-time students.

• You do not need to make any payment in order to have it. It is free for Sabancı University full-time students.

• It is renewed annually every September or February, depending on your university registration period, due to your continuation of your studies.

• It has basic coverage and you can request the benefit table from healthcenter@sabanciuniv.edu

• It has limits. So, the limit will decrease due to your processes at the hospital.

• It can be used for residence permit purposes.

After your university enrollment, your Aksigorta insurance is automatically created. Thus, you do not need to take any action on it.

You may request for your a soft copy of Aksigorta Insurance document from irolegal@sabanciuniv.edu

You may ask your any question related to health insurance, coverage, and for your well-being to healthcenter@sabanciuniv.edu

**2. General Health Insurance/GHI/GSS) or ''SGK'' in Turkish**

• It is state-funded health insurance.

• It is available for international students who obtain a residence permit card and who are registered to a university in Turkey.

• In order to have GHI, you need to apply to the Social Security City Directorate or to the Social Security Center (SGM) of the district in which the student resides within 3 months following your university registration (first registration to the university) and after receiving your foreign national ID number. (If you do not apply within this period, you will not have the chance to apply to GHI again) For the 2023 year, the annual GHI premium is around 4800 TL (approximately 200 Dollars annually in 2024).

• Students who do not apply for the GHI within the 3-month legal period for the application cannot benefit from this right later. Thus, students are strongly advised to have this procedure.

• The list of the Social Security Centers (SGMs) in Istanbul is available here.

https://www.google.com/maps/search/SGK/@40.9930338,28.9700699,12z?entry=ttu

**How to apply for it:**

• Visit www.turkiye.gov.tr and log in with your foreign ID number and edevlet password ( If you do not have e-devlet password click here to learn how to get it.)

• Search for "Yabancı Uyruklu Öğrencilerin GSS Başvurusu ve Takibi" and then click "başvuru yap" (apply) link

• After your application, wait for 2-3 days and visit the same page to check your application status and make sure that it is approved

• Visit https://www.turkiye.gov.tr/sosyal-guvenlik-sosyal-guvenlik-kurumukart-ile-prim-odeme-uygulamasi login with your e-devlet password, select "Diğer Tahsilatlar"-"GSS Prim" and enter your foreign ID number that starts with 99-98 and then make the payment online

• After 30 days following your payment, visit https://www.turkiye.gov.tr/spasmustahaklik-sorgulama and get a proof document (müstehaklık). The document should state "Müstehaktır, provizyon alabilir."

• You can visit the İstanbul Immigration Office and submit this document along with a petition stating you applied for General Health Insurance with your residence permit. You do not need to take an appointment to submit it. Students who do not apply for the GSS within the 3-month legal period for the application cannot benefit from this right afterward. Therefore, students are strongly advised not to ignore this procedure. If you change your program or your program level (e.g. from undergraduate to master’s) you have the right to apply again.

**Please note that all students have to have a valid health insurance during their stay in Turkey. You can use the ones stated above. If you have a private health insurance on your own apart from Aksigorta, if your health insurance expires, you have to renew your health insurance in order to use for your residence permit card applications. Also, you have to be careful about its validity for the residency purposes.**

*\*Since the mentioned processes are managed and regulated by state bodies such as the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the practices are open to change.*

title: Health Services - Study in Türkiye
text:
**Insurance Information**

People who come to Turkey as international students are required to have health insurance during their official residence. There are two types of health insurance. If you want, you can go to any private health insurance agency and make use of policies tailored for foreigners. Keep in mind that the coverage of these policies is limited and is only valid in hospitals where the insurance company is contracted!

Another option is General Health Insurance (GSS). This type of insurance, governed by the Social Security Institution of the Republic of Turkey, will give you the right to benefit from treatment in all state hospitals free of charge. In this way, you can get your prescription medications by paying a very low amount of contribution. The most important point to note with GSS is that you must make your application within three months following your university registration.

Renewal of your private or general health insurance every year is both a legal necessity and will save you from paying the treatment fee for an unexpected health problem.

**Health services**

All universities in Turkey have their own health centers. In these centers, which are generally known as MEDİKO, all students can easily perform basic health checks and medical examinations. You can contact the university's relevant departments for detailed information about health center of your university.

Pharmacies in Turkey are open until 19:00 in the evening except on Sundays. After 19:00 and on Sundays, a certain number of on-duty pharmacies are in service in each city. Emergency service units of hospitals and university health centers provide services 7/24 for emergencies.

For ambulance services, call center number to call for free from anywhere in Turkey is 112

title: Bilkent 2026-2027 Registration Guide (international students)
text:
Congratulations on your acceptance to Bilkent University!

You have taken an important step towards adding an international dimension to your
education.

Registration for the 2026-2027 academic year will take place 31 August- 1 September
2026 on campus at the Odeon Amphi Theater next to the main campus entrance.

DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR REGISTRATION
1. Photocopies of the passport pages including,
a) identification information,
b) stamp of the latest entry date to Turkey, and for students from countries which are not
exempt from the visa requirement to enter Turkey,
c) visa issued by the Turkish Consulate in home country.
Students, who live in Turkey, must submit a photocopy of their residence permit.
Students, who have a diplomatic ID or a “Blue Card”, must submit the photocopy of these
documents.

For students, who will be under the age of 18 at the time of registration to the
university; you are required to provide an official “Letter of Parental Consent”
(‘Muvaffakatname’ in Turkish) given by the parents living abroad and their Birth
Certificate. Your parents should issue the letter of consent and the birth certificate in
your home country. They are required to state that they allow you to travel to Turkey,
reside and study in Turkey in the letter of consent. The letter of consent and the birth
certificate must be apostilled and the apostilled version should be translated and
notarized in Turkey. If apostille convention is not available in your country, the
documents must be approved by the related country’s Consulate and Republic of Turkey
Ministry of Foreign Affairs and notarized translation in Turkish.

This is a mandatory task, when students will be applying for an education residence
permit right after they register to Bilkent University.

Please note: Letter of consent and the birth certificate is not mandatory for students,
whose country has the visa requirement to enter Turkey (e.g. USA, Pakistan, etc.).

2.
Two (2) biometric photographs in ICAO standards for the residence permit
application, taken in the last 6 months (https://en.goc.gov.tr/about-the-usage-of-
photographs-in-residence-permit-application).
3.
Original and photocopies of high school diploma/graduation certificate and transcript.
IGCSE students are also required to submit the original and photocopies of their high
school diploma/graduation certificate and transcripts, besides their O/AS/A level
certificates.
The original high school diploma/graduation certificate and transcript must have an
apostille. For detailed information about apostille, please click.
4.
The “Equivalency Certificate” of high school diploma. (for Turkish Citizens only;
who have completed their high school education outside of Turkey)
This certificate is a legal requirement which verifies that the high school diploma is
equivalent to a Turkish high school diploma.

Before leaving for Turkey, the student can obtain this certificate from the Turkish
Consulate in her/his home country OR after the student arrives, from the Ministry of
National Education of the Republic of Turkey at the following address:

Ankara İl Milli Eğitim Müdürlüğü
İ Blok Kültür Bölümü Beşevler, Ankara
Phone: +90 312 212 4642
To apply for the equivalency certificate, students must submit their original high school
diploma and a transcript listing all of the courses taken in high school including the grades
and credit hours for each, accompanied by a translation in English or Turkish.

The equivalency certificate requirement for IGCSE students is as following;
For 5 (five) subjects:
Option a) 2 Advanced levels (at least D grade) + 3 Ordinary levels (at least D grade)
Option b) 2 Advanced levels (at least D grade) + 1 Advanced Subsidiary level (at least D
grade) + 2 Ordinary levels (at least D grade)

For 4 (four) subjects:
Option a) 3 Advanced levels (at least D grade) + 1 Ordinary level (at least D grade)

The subjects mentioned in the options above must be different than each other.
For instance, if a student has only 2 A Levels in Mathematics and Physics, and has only 3
O Levels in Mathematics, Computer Studies and Chemistry, she/he cannot obtain an
equivalency certificate. The student must have 2 different A Level subjects + 3 different O
Level subjects and the subject grades must be at least “D”.

If a student fulfills all the requirements of one of the options above but, has extra
subjects and grades (even if the grade is E), she/he can still obtain the equivalency
certificate.

Students, who studied in the distance learning format, can obtain the equivalency
certificate only if they were present in the country of their high school, during the whole
high school education period.

Students, who do not meet one of these mentioned requirements, will not be able to get
an equivalency certificate.

Since the equivalency certificate is a legal requirement to register to any university in
Turkey, students who are not able to get the equivalency certificate will NOT be able to
register to Bilkent University, even if they get official admission.

5.
Original and photocopies of National/International Test/Certificates (SAT, IB, ACT,
IGCSE, Olympiad, WAEC, TQDK, Baccalaureate, etc.), if uploaded during application.
Official SAT scores must be sent to Bilkent University directly from the College Board
prior to the registrations in August (code - 9877).
Bilkent University reserves the right to verify the validity of exam scores.
6.
English Language Proficiency exam score sheets (IELTS/TOEFL) must be sent to
Bilkent University directly from the related institutions prior to the registrations in August.

(Please see “English Language Proficiency” section below for detailed information.)
The photocopy of the exam score report should be submitted during registration as well.
7.
Tuition fee payment receipt.
Students must pay their fall semester tuition fee before the registration.
(Please see “Tuition Fee” section below for detailed information.)
8.
If you are a Turkish citizen, you are also required to submit photocopies of the
pages of each entry and exit stamp during the passport control at the airport from the
country you completed your high school education (another option is to login to the E-devlet
system and obtain the same information at “Emniyet Genel Müdürlüğü>’Yurda giriş-çıkış
belge sorgulama’ section). This is a requirement of the Higher Education Council in Turkey
implemented for all Turkish citizens who have completed their high school education abroad.
Please note: If the documents listed above are in a language other than English or Turkish,
students must provide a translation by a certified translator along with the copy of the
original document.

VISA INFORMATION

It is very important that you confirm your country’s visa regime with Turkey via the Turkish
Consulate in your country.

The visa processing time may take between 6-8 weeks in some countries.
If you are coming from a country, which is exempted from the visa requirement to enter
Turkey, you do not have to apply to the Turkish Consulates for any kind of visa. You may
directly come to Turkey without obtaining a visa.
However, if you are coming from a country, which is not exempted from the visa
requirement to enter Turkey, you have to apply for any kind of visa prior to coming to
Bilkent, Turkey. You should visit the Turkish Consulate in your country to apply for a visa as
soon as you receive your official acceptance letter from Bilkent University.
STUDENT RESIDENCE PERMIT
International students are required to obtain a student residence permit within a maximum
of thirty (30) days after entering Turkey.

Office of International Students will provide detailed information about the student residence
permit application procedure during registration.

Students must submit a copy of their student residence permit to the Office of International
Students as soon as they receive it from the Ankara Migration Management Office.

TUITION FEE
The tuition fee for the 2026-2027 academic year is 18,400 USD (10% VAT included). The
tuition fee information can be viewed at https://w3.bilkent.edu.tr/bilkent/international-and-
other-students-tuition-fees/.

The tuition fee can be paid in two equal installments by the due dates before the Fall and
Spring semesters.

Students must pay their semester tuition fee before the registration.
Payments can be made in cash to any branch of Yapı Kredi Bank- (Bilkent branch, on
campus inside the Rectorate’s Building if you have a bank account at this bank), Garanti
Bank (Bilkent branch) or Is Bank (any branches) in Turkey. Since you will need your Bilkent
student ID number to make the payment, you may call the Office of International Students
to learn it. There will be no bank representatives in the registration area.
Students may also wire transfer the tuition fee from their home country at least one week
before the registration date to the bank account provided below. Please note that students
should have their first name and last name written on the bank receipt and that this receipt
needs to be submitted to the registration desk during registration.
Garanti Bank / Bilkent Branch
USD Account Number: 393-9088737
USD IBAN: TR10 0006 2000 3930 0009 0887 37
SWIFT CODE: TGBATRIS

All students, who are admitted to Bilkent University in accordance with the regulations stated
in the Higher Education Council’s “Guidelines for Admission of Students From Abroad” are
considered international students and are required to pay the international student tuition
fees.

ADVANCE PAYMENT
The advance payment of 700 USD that students had done for securing their admission at
Bilkent, will be deducted from their 2026-2027 academic year spring semester tuition fee.
Students who are on full scholarship, will get a refund of their advance payment in the 2026-
2027 academic year spring semester when they open a bank account in Turkey (Students
can open a bank account in Turkey, upon receiving their student residence permit card).
Please be informed that if the candidate does not register to Bilkent University within the
2026-2027 academic year, the advance payment will not be refunded.
DORMITORY REGISTRATION
Bilkent University offers on-campus housing for both national and international students. The
dormitories provide a safe, clean, and comfortable atmosphere for more than 4,800
students.
For more detailed information on the dormitory options and fees, please visit
http://yurtlar.bilkent.edu.tr/en/dormitory-fees/.
Students will be able to register to the dormitories after completing their registration to the
university on 31 August- 1 September 2026. They can apply to the Dormitories Registration
Desk located in the registration area by presenting their Bilkent student ID card and

dormitory fee for the fall semester. After completing dormitory registration, students will be
entitled to check into the dormitories on the same day.

Those, who do not register to the dormitories during the registration period (31 August- 1
September 2026), will lose their chance of a guaranteed dormitory room.

Dormitories Contact Information:
Bilkent University
Dormitories Management 06800, Bilkent / ANKARA
Phone: +90 312 290 4002
Fax: +90 312 266 4069
E-mail: yurt@bilkent.edu.tr

ENGLISH LANGUAGE PROFICIENCY

The medium of instruction at Bilkent University is English. Students may present results from
one of the recognized international exams or take Bilkent University’s own Proficiency in
Academic English (PAE) exam upon arrival and registration. Students who cannot meet
proficiency requirements are required to attend the English Language Preparatory Program.
Recognized external exams and required scores are:
IELTS – 6.5 overall, with a minimum of 5.5 on each section
(IELTS score sheet should be sent directly from the test center to Bilkent University)

GE 100 Introduction to Academic Life, designed as a one-credit mandatory course, will take

The GE 100 Introduction to Academic Life course is designed to welcome and acclimatize

The university offers the course to introduce its programs and facilities to all incoming students.
The program booklet will be provided at registration.
STARS-SRS SERVICE

STARS is the name of the Bilkent University academic information service. Students have
access to the STARS system through the SRS (Student Review System) module. This service
allows you to learn your PAE exam location and results, to register for courses and to access

Please follow the link https://stars.bilkent.edu.tr/accounts/login to login to STARS-SRS.

GENERAL HEALTH INSURANCE (GSS)
International students are required to enroll in the General Health Insurance (GHI) system and
to renew the enrollment every year. The fee for the GHI is approximately 2000 Turkish Lira
(TL)/per year. Further information will be provided during registration.

APOSTILLE
An apostille is a certification method to verify that the document you hold is legitimate and
authentic. The apostilles must be attached to your original high school diploma and
transcript (should not be a separate document).

Not all countries are issuing apostilles. You may find the list of countries that issues apostilles
at https://www.hcch.net/en/instruments/conventions/status-table/?cid=41.
You can also visit https://www.hcch.net/en/instruments/conventions/authorities1/?cid=41 to
find the exact office in your home country that issues an apostille.

If your country is not issuing apostille, you should learn about how your documents can be
certified in your home country. You should contact the related governmental office, which
may be the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Justice or Governor’s
Office in your home country, to get your documents certified.

Please note that you should get your apostille/certification in your home country before you
come to Bilkent University for registration, since you will not be able to obtain it in Turkey.

title: CoHE Scholarships
text:
CoHE Scholarships

**Mevlana Değişim Programı:** Yurt içinde eğitim veren yükseköğretim kurumları ile yurt dışında eğitim veren yükseköğretim kurumları arasında öğrenci ve öğretim elemanı değişimini öngören bir programdır.

**Farabi Değişim Programı:** Yurt içindeki yükseköğretim kurumları arasında öğrenci ve öğretim üyesi değişim programıdır.

**100/2000 YÖK Doktora Bursu:** Ülkemiz için öncelikli alanlarında nitelikli bilgi üretmek amaçlı doktoralı insan kaynağına olan ihtiyacını karşılamak üzere, devlet üniversitelerindeki doktora programlarında öğrenim gören öğrencileri desteklemek için Başkanlığımız tarafından verilen bir doktora burs programıdır.

**Yabancı Uyruklu Öğrencilere Burs:** Yükseköğretim kurulunun işbirliği protokolü ve/veya mutabakat zaptı imzaladığı ülkelerden gelen ve devlet yükseköğretim kurumlarına yerleştirilen yabancı uyruklu öğrencilere verilen burs programıdır.

**YÖK Destek Bursu:** 2016-2017 eğitim öğretim yılından başlayarak yükseköğretim sistemimizde her düzeyde niteliğin arttırılmasına yönelik ülkemiz için büyük önem arz eden Yükseköğretim Kurulu tarafından belirlenecek Devlet üniversitelerindeki desteklenmesine karar verilen lisans programlarına ilk üç sırada yerleşen ve kayıt yaptıran öğrencilere Yükseköğretim Kurulunca belirlenen miktarda ve sürede verilen aylık burs programıdır.

**Proje Tabanlı Uluslararası Değişim Programı** : 2016-2017 eğitim öğretim yılından başlayarak "Proje Tabanlı Uluslararası Değişim Programı" ile YÖK Yürütme Kurulunca belirlenen alanlarda yükseköğretim kurumlarımız tarafından hazırlanan projelerin Başkanlığımızca desteklenmesine ilişkin programdır.

**YÖK Türkoloji Bursu:** Yükseköğretim Kurulunun işbirliği ve/veya mutabakat zaptı imzaladığı ülkeler öncelikli olmak üzere, Yükseköğretim Kurulunca belirlenecek yurtdışındaki ülke ve yükseköğretim kurumlarında Türk Dili ve Edebiyatı, Türkoloji ve Türk Dili programlarında öğrenim gören ve bulunduğu ülkenin vatandaşı olan lisans öğrencilerine verilen bir burs programıdır.

**Yurt Dışı Araştırma Bursları:** Devlet yükseköğretim kurumlarında görev yapmakta ve doktora tez aşamasında olan araştırma görevlilerinin mecburi hizmet yükümlülüğüne ilişkin hükümler uygulanmaksızın en az altı ay veya en fazla bir yıl süreyle yurtdışına burslu ve yol giderleri karşılanarak gönderilmesine ilişkin verilen burs programıdır.

**YÖK-Yabancı Dil Eğitim Bursu:** Devlet üniversitelerinin doktora derecesine sahip araştırma görevlisi, öğretim görevlisi veya Dr. öğretim üyesi kadrolarında görev yapmakta olan öğretim elemanlarının, yabancı dil seviyesini yükseltmek için yurtdışında katıldıkları yabancı dil kursu giderlerinin desteklenmesi amacıyla verilecek burs programıdır.

title: Residence Permit - METU
text:
## Residence Permit

**Upcoming days for the Migration Office Mobile Service Point on Campus (for fingerprints and address registration):**

**03.11.2026 - 10.11.2026 - 26.11.2026**

**Location:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/uWWgWBxjYxxkWRVk8

Student residence permit procedures for undergraduate, master's, and doctoral students are carried out within the scope of the "Cooperation Protocol on Residence Permit Applications of International Students" signed between the Presidency of Migration Management and the Council of Higher Education (YÖK) on 15/11/2023 and entered into force on 29/11/2023.

**Step 1.** The student must complete the "pre-registration form" at https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr within the legal period, complete the online student residence permit application, and complete the appointment selection, then download the residence permit application form as a PDF. Depending on your situation, you may follow the first application, transfer, or extension steps on this page.

**Step 2.** Even if you complete the appointment step and the system assigns you an appointment date, you will NOT attend your appointment at the Migration Office for student residence permit applications. You must submit your documents to ISO on the first Thursdays following your e-ikamet application. We will take the documents to the Migration Office periodically. You will not go to the Migration Office unless you receive a specific email from us instructing you to do so.

**Step 3.** We will collect documents at ISO only on Thursdays from 09:30 to 12:00 and from 13:30 to 17:00. We do not accept residence permit application documents on other days.

Ankara Migration Office does not process files that are more than thirty days past the student's e-ikamet application date. Our office submits documents to the Ankara Migration Office every two weeks. Therefore, to avoid such delays, it is important that students submit their application documents to our office on the first Thursday following the date of their e-ikamet application.

**Step 4.** After submitting the documents to the Migration Office, they will inform ISO if any document or information is missing for any student. If so, we will notify you via your METU email. It is your responsibility to check your emails and act according to the instructions provided.

**Step 5.** You can follow the status of your application via e-ikamet website. Once your card is ready, it will be posted to your address.

ISO functions only as a document collection desk. If you have any problem or question regarding your residence permit, you must first contact 157 to receive the correct information directly from the Migration Office. If you still need assistance, please contact our office through the contact channels listed here: https://iso.metu.edu.tr/en/contact

Although ISO's involvement has increased under this new protocol, it is still the student's responsibility to follow the required procedures and regulations regarding residence permits. The Migration Office remains the sole authority responsible for evaluating residence permit applications. Therefore, apart from collecting and submitting application documents to the Migration Office, the university has no involvement, responsibility, or authority in residence permit procedures.

----------------

### REQUIRED DOCUMENTS

*Click each item to expand and see the details.*

**1. Residence Permit Application Form**

Students who will enroll in undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs must apply by selecting the "Student Residence Permit" type among residence permit categories. You must complete the online application form at https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/. After completing the form, download it as a PDF, print the first two pages, and sign it on the first page. (Please download the PDF immediately after completing the form. Do not postpone it or plan to download it later because after your appointment date has passed, you will no longer be able to access this PDF via e-Residence.)

While filling out the form, remember that only fields written in red are mandatory. Fields written in black do not need to be filled in.

If you have renewed your passport while in Türkiye and have not entered Türkiye with your new passport, enter your previous passport number and issue date, and the expiry date of your new passport.

For the start date of your studies at METU, write your initial registration date, which you can find via program no. 61 at https://student.metu.edu.tr/. For the end date of your studies, if you will graduate at the end of the fall semester, enter any date in March of the expected graduation year. If you will graduate at the end of the spring semester, enter any date in September of the expected graduation year.

The form requires two addresses: the university address and your permanent address. Please refer to this document for address details. After completing the form, print it, sign it, and include it in your application file.

**2. Passport or passport substitute document copy**

A valid passport and copy (identity page, last entry page, and visa page if any). (Once you submit your documents to ISO, we will handle the "true copy" stamp procedure. Please bring your passport and photocopies with you.)

If you have recently renewed your passport, please bring both passports with their photocopies.

**3. Residence Permit Information Form (not required if this is your first semester in your program)**

It must include registration date, foreign ID number, and expected graduation date.

The student registration must be active in the YÖK system.

Apply and download this document via program no. 205 at https://student.metu.edu.tr/. YOU MUST PRINT THE FORM AFTER DOWNLOADING IT. This document requires approval from the Registrar‚Äôs Office after online application. Therefore, do not leave it to the last minute and apply a few days in advance.

**4. Proof of payment of residence permit card fee**

Students applying for a student residence permit pay only 964.0 TL (for 2026) card fee. Visa fees and residence permit fees are not required.

To pay the card fee, first visit https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/, then select "*Göç İdaresi İkamet Tezkeresi Harcı Ödeme*" and enter the accrue number (*tahakkuk numarası*) obtained at the end of your online application. Then complete the payment online and obtain the receipt. **PLEASE USE A COMPUTER WHILE MAKING THE PAYMENT ON THIS WEBSITE. DO NOT USE YOUR MOBILE PHONES!**

**5. Document showing place of residence**

1\. If living in your own property: a copy of the title deed and a recent utility bill (water, electricity, natural gas, landline, etc.), or a subscription contract, or a numbering (*numarataj*) certificate from the municipality. (For extension applications, a residence registration document is sufficient.)

2\. If renting: an e-signed rental contract via e-devlet or a notarized rental agreement. The landlord's identity information and authorization documents (if applicable) must be attached.

3\. If staying in hotels, motels, or similar: a lodging document is required, along with proof of payment. AIRBNB reservations are not accepted.

4\. If staying in student dormitories: a signed and stamped/sealed document from the dormitory administration. The document must be recently issued. **YOUR ROOM NUMBER SHOULD BE STATED IN THE DOCUMENT.**

5\. If using a third person's address: a notarized undertaking from that person is required. If married, both spouses must provide consent. Address registration of the sponsor is mandatory. (A sponsor may support a maximum of two foreigners. If the sponsor is a foreigner, the residence permit duration of the applicant cannot exceed the sponsor's legal stay period.

**6. Address Registration Document (Yerlesim Yeri Belgesi) Only for extension applications**

NOTE (Address Registration): For extension applications, completed address registration is required. Applicants must submit a residence registration document via https://www.turkiye.gov.tr/nvi-yerlesim-yeri-ve-diger-adres-belgesi-sorg... If your address does not appear here, you must update it at the Migration Office by submitting a valid proof of address to register your address. After completing your registration, your address information will be available through the e-Government Portal. You should then obtain the relevant document ("Yerlesim Yeri Belgesi" in Turkish) from the link above and submit it to the ISO along with the other documents listed here.

**7. Health insurance**

In principle, foreigners must submit insurance covering the entire requested residence permit period. At least one of the following documents is required:

(1) Private health insurance policy covering the residence period. First page of the insurance policy is sufficient. You can purchase private health insurance for more than one year, which is highly recommended to be eligible for a longer residence permit.

(2) If you will have government insurance, then an official document of application to Social Security Institution for General Health Insurance (GSS) or an official signed/sealed provision document from SGK.

(3) Nationals whose healthcare is covered by bilateral agreements are exempt.

**8. For students under 18 years old**

(a) Birth certificate (If parents cannot be identified in official ID documents, an official birth certificate is required.)

(b) Consent letter (*muvafakatname*)

In case of divorce, an approved custody document, or proof of joint custody, or a notarized consent letter provided by the other parent in cases where the other parent has visitation rights, is required.

In the event of the death of one parent, an officially certified death certificate is required.

If a court decision of absence (missing person declaration) has been issued regarding one of the parents, an officially certified certificate of absence must be provided.

**For minors entering with visa exemption or other visa types, guardian documents and consent letters are required. For those entering with a student visa, these documents are not required. Therefore, even if you are a citizen of a visa-exempt country, obtaining a student visa before coming to Türkiye will save you from the additional documentation and bureaucratic burdens associated with being under 18, and is therefore highly important.**

**9. Other Documents (If needed)**

Additional information or documents may be requested by the Migration Office during evaluation.

### IMPORTANT NOTES

1. International students are called for fingerprint registration at times determined by the Migration Office. If you have already provided your fingerprints to the Migration Office, you do not need to do this again.
2. You do not need to obtain a visa to enter Türkiye during the period your residence permit is valid. For example, when returning to Türkiye from a visit to your home country during a semester break, you may present your residence permit instead of a visa.
3. Migration Office takes the online application date into consideration. In all circumstances, you must complete your e-ikamet application before your residence permit, visa, or visa-free stay period expires.
4. In case of any change in name/surname, marital status, address, passport, department, or program, etc., the Ankara Migration Office must be informed immediately.
5. In case of loss of the physical residece permit card, the Ankara Migration Office must be notified immediately.
6. The list of students who withdraw from the program voluntarily or are dismissed from the program is submitted to the Ankara Migration Office every semester. Their student residence permits are canceled accordingly. Therefore, students must carefully follow their residence procedures.
7. According to information received from the Migration Office (as of June 2026), when you graduate from your program and if your residence permit card's expiry date is after your graduation date, you may stay in Türkiye until the expiry date stated on your card. Those who wish to stay longer must apply for a short-term residence permit within six months following graduation, before their student residence permit expires. Each new graduation at a higher education level grants a separate right to apply for a post-graduation short-term residence permit. Therefore, you may apply for this permit after your undergraduate, master's, and PhD graduations separately.
8. When applying for an extension, after the positive evaluation of your application, your new card will not be printed until your previous card expires. Therefore, if you need proof of your new permit before your new card is issued, you may obtain a document via: https://www.turkiye.gov.tr/goc-idaresi-ikamet-izni-kisisel-bilgi-sorgula...
9. If you wish to leave Türkiye while your residence permit application is under evaluation by the Migration Office, please contact our office so that we can coordinate with the Migration Office regarding possible scenarios.
10. If you remain enrolled in a double major program after graduating from your first major, you will still be eligible to extend your student residence permit. However, if you remain enrolled in a minor program after graduating from your major, you will not be eligible for an extension. In this case, please contact us for assistance.
11. The expiry date of the residence permit issued depends on three main factors: your expected graduation date, your health insurance coverage period, and your passport validity.
12. For example, if your expected graduation is at the end of the 2027-2028 spring semester, and your health insurance duration and passport validity allow it, your student residence permit may be issued until 30 November 2028. Similarly, if your expected graduation is at the end of the 2028-2029 fall semester, your permit may be issued until 31 March 2029, provided your insurance and passport validity allow it.
13. Private health insurance policies can be purchased for multiple years. Such long-term insurance is beneficial as it prevents the need for annual renewal applications, repeated document collection, and annual residence permit card fee payments.
14. It is also important to extend your passport before coming to Türkiye so that you have a passport covering your full period of study, which helps you obtain a longer-term residence permit in a single application.
15. The student residence permit does not automatically grant residence rights to parents or other relatives of the student.
16. Regarding work and work permits, please see here: https://iso.metu.edu.tr/en/work-permits

Migration Office Call Center: **157**

Email address: **ankara.ikamet@goc.gov.tr**

Migration Office Address: **Barbaros Mahallesi, Binnaz Sk. No:2, 06680 Çankaya/Ankara**

title: FAQ - Study in Türkiye
text:
- ##### SYBS: What is Level Determination Examination (STS)? SYBS: What is Level Determination Examination (STS)? It is a written examination for assessment and evaluation in writing in terms of qualifications and basic achievements.

- ##### Who can apply to STS? Who can apply to STS? If diploma is taken from one of the programs subject to the STS process, the applicant may apply to STS without waiting for decision of STS.

- ##### Which institution does STS and when? Which institution does STS and when? The exam is held twice a year in the field of Medical Doctorate, and held once a year in the fields of ”Dentistry” and “Teaching“ by ÖSYM. Exam is held at least once a year by the universities determined by Council of Higher Education in the fields of Engineering, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, Occupational Therapy, Law, Turkish / Turkish Language and Literature and other education and teaching fields required by the Commission. Examination calendar is determined by Council of Higher Education in December each year and is announced on the Web page.

- ##### How many points should be taken to be considered successful from STS? How many points should be taken to be considered successful from STS? Raw scores are calculated by subtracting one-quarter of number of wrong answers from total number of correct answers. Minimum points to be taken are as follows: 35 out of 100 for Medical Doctorate, 40 out of 100 for Dentistry, 40 over 100 for "Teaching” in KPSS Educational Sciences exam. At least 80 points out of 100 from Foreign Language Level Assessment Test (YDS) or equivalent score from exams accepted by Council of Higher Education (For equivalent exams and scores, ÖSYM's current Foreign Language Equivalence Table is taken as basis).

- ##### Are there exams that are considered equivalent to STS for "medical doctorate"? Are there exams that are considered equivalent to STS for "medical doctorate"? USMLE-Step3, PLAB-Part2, AMC-Clinical Examinations, MCCQE-Part2, Arztliche Prüfungen (3AP, Staats Examen) Examinations in foreign countries and Structured Clinical Examination in Turkey are accepted as equivalent to STS, and candidates who are successful in these exams are considered successful from STS in the field of ”Medical Doctorate”.

- ##### What is recognition? What is recognition? Acceptance by Council of Higher education that an overseas higher education institution and a relevant program of this institution are authorized to give academic degrees. Relevant higher education institution should be recognized by competent authorities in the country where it operates as as an institution authorized to issue a higher education diploma and this institution must be accredited by recognized accreditation or quality assurance organizations.

- ##### What is equivalence? What is equivalence? It is the determination of equivalence of associate degree, undergraduate and master's diplomas obtained from overseas higher education institutions and programs to associate degree, Bachelor's and master's degrees awarded by higher education institutions in Turkey in terms of achievements in related education level.

- ##### Can graduates of an unrecognized school apply for equivalence? Can graduates of an unrecognized school apply for equivalence? In order to be able to evaluate the applications for equivalence, higher education institution giving the diploma and the education program should be recognized as an institution authorized by competent authorities of the country in which it is active, and should be accredited by accreditation or quality assurance institutions and should be recognized by Council of Higher Education. Diploma equivalence applications from higher education institutions that do not provide these considerations are rejected.

- ##### Where should copies of original documents and translations be made? Where should copies of original documents and translations be made? Copies and translations of equivalence application documents must be approved by Notaries in Turkey or by foreign representations of Republic of Turkey in the country where the diploma was obtained.

- ##### What are the stages of equivalence process? What are the stages of equivalence process?
1. a) On-line application,
2. b) Document originals are presented to CoHE and the application is activated,
3. c) Confirmation process,
4. d) Review of content of education,
(Opinion can be obtained from Science Field Advisory Committees or Universities)
1. e) Prepared review report is assessed by Recognition and Equivalence Commission,
2. f) Final decision is given by Council of Higher Education.

- ##### What decisions are taken in equivalence assessment process? What decisions are taken in equivalence assessment process? Three different decisions can be made as a result of a equivalence assessment: Equivalence, SYBS, Rejection.

- ##### In what cases is Equivalence Certificate issued? In what cases is Equivalence Certificate issued? In case equivalent of qualified field and degree of the program in which the application is made is included in Turkish Higher Education System and the qualification is assessed to provide necessary academic and professional achievements, EQUIVALANCE CERTIFICATE is issued.

- ##### What is Structured Clinical Examination? What is Structured Clinical Examination? In order to test clinical knowledge and skills by universities determined by Council of Higher Education, it is mainly done in the form of simulation, models and practical applications through patients. Additional written examinations can be made if required by the university. Only the candidates who have been approved for STS can apply for this exam and in order to be successful, 50 out of 100 points must be taken.

- ##### SYBS: What is Identification of Scientific Identity? SYBS: What is Identification of Scientific Identity? Within the scope of the STS decision taken during the equivalence process, it is a measurement and evaluation process which includes oral examination (written when necessary) and practical implementation stages and accepted as equivalent to STS.

- ##### In which fields and by which institutions does Identification of Scientific Identity is made? In which fields and by which institutions does Identification of Scientific Identity is made? This process is carried out periodically by relevant Universities in the fields of Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, Occupational Therapy, Veterinary Medicine, Midwifery, Speech and Language Therapy, Nutrition and Dietetics, Audiology, Child Development. Candidates must receive 50 points over 100 in order to be considered successful.

- ##### Where and how to do Clinical Practice? Where and how to do Clinical Practice? Candidates who have decided to make clinical practices choose three state universities in writing, and according to the opinion of Commission of Equivalence Executive Board, they are placed in one of these choices. Candidates are actively involved in training seminars, outpatient clinics and clinical studies of main branches of clinical practice. In the applications to be made to the patients, the candidates are in the status of a student, they cannot intervene directly to the patient alone, they are involved in diagnosis and treatment services under the accompaniment and supervision of experts in the related department.

- ##### How much is the service fee for Recognition and Equivalence process? How much is the service fee for Recognition and Equivalence process? When the service fee is deposited, information should be written about the reason of request for deposited fee in Description section.
- The service fee for associate degree, undergraduate and graduate <u>equivalence applications</u> is 150 TL.
- The service fee for other transactions is 50 TL.

- ##### Can anyone make Recognition and Equivalence applications on behalf of applicant? Can anyone make Recognition and Equivalence applications on behalf of applicant?
- Diploma Equivalence Application and Graduation Recognition Certificate Application can be made by Diploma holder or someone with “Official Power of Attorney”.
- Institution/School Recognition Documents may be requested by others instead of original applicant.

- ##### What academic degrees can we apply for equivalence at Council of Higher Education. What academic degrees can we apply for equivalence at Council of Higher Education. Equivalence in Council of Higher Education is performed only for associate degree, undergraduate and graduate degrees. Equivalence of doctoral and higher academic degrees is performed within the Interuniversity board and equivalence of diplomas in secondary education are in the field of Ministry of National Education.

- ##### Where should I apply for a doctoral or higher degrees? Where should I apply for a doctoral or higher degrees? Equivalence process of doctoral and higher diplomas is done by Interuniversity Board

- ##### To get undergraduate education in Turkey, should we take equivalence for associate degree from abroad? To get undergraduate education in Turkey, should we take equivalence for associate degree from abroad? It is left to universities that courses of associate degree diploma will be accepted for transfer in the undergraduate program; no equivalence application is required.

- ##### What are the documents required for the equivalence application? What are the documents required for the equivalence application? Applicant's identity, documents for equivalence of required qualification (diploma, transcript, transfer transcript, diploma supplement, thesis, internship documents, etc.) and approved translations of these documents, as well as safety entry-exit records for equivalence are the basic documents requested. Besides these documents, other documents written in the regulation and, if requested, additional documents should be submitted for equivalence evaluation.

- ##### Should document originals be submitted for equivalence application? Should document originals be submitted for equivalence application? In Office of Equivalence of CoHE, it is checked by the officer making the application acceptance and preliminary review whether the document originals, approved copies, and translations are original documents, and whether they correspond with the copies in the system, and they are returned to the applicant on the same day.

- ##### What is a Diploma confirmation? What is a Diploma confirmation? It is the correspondence made with Republic of Turkey Foreign Representatives, foreign and domestic institutions and organizations to obtain information about the quality and quantity of the higher education of the person concerned. Relevant investigation and information requests are made in accordance with the "consent statement" provided by the applicant.

- ##### In what cases is Apostille necessary? In what cases is Apostille necessary? Apostille is a document approval system that enables legitimacy of a document to be legally used in another country. This document, valid between member or party states in Hague Conference, can be obtained for documents such as diplomas, transcripts, diploma supplements included in the equivalence application documents.

- ##### What is Course Completion Decision? What is Course Completion Decision? In the case that diploma program required for equivalence is found to be deficient in the course and achievements to be taken in the same field in our country and academic and/or professional gains are inadequate; it is the decision made by the Equivalence Commission to take the course again taking into account the opinions of BAD or University. Candidates given decision to complete the course choose three state universities in writing, and according to the opinion of Commission of Equivalence Executive Board, they are placed in one of these choices.

- ##### SYBS: What does Clinical Practice mean? SYBS: What does Clinical Practice mean? Clinical Practice is the whole of the practices carried out under the supervision of the relevant specialist physicians to ensure consistence and adaptation to diagnostic and therapeutic applications in Turkey, also aiming at the completion of clinical practical applications which are incomplete within the scope of SYBS. To ensure achievements of the practices of diploma fields such as "Medical Doctorate, Dentistry, Veterinary, Nursing, Midwifery, Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation, Occupational Therapy, Architecture and Engineering", which allows for the execution of the profession, completion of courses and internships, clinical practice or projects may be required in order to provide the necessary adaptations. Relevant decisions are given within the framework of the vocational fields guidelines.

- ##### What does Science Field Advisory (BAD) commission mean? What does Science Field Advisory (BAD) commission mean? This commission is a commission composed of specialized faculty members who are working in various universities, in order to get the necessary opinions in various graduation fields during the process of recognition and equivalence applications.

- ##### How does the equivalence process of the "pharmacy" field work? How does the equivalence process of the "pharmacy" field work? Equivalence applications in the field of pharmacy are examined by Commission on Equivalence in line with the opinion of the University; in case the applicant's level of education is found inadequate in terms of time and achievements, the applicant is included in the scientific examination of a university determined by the Board, provided that he / she completes his / her incomplete courses and internships

- ##### Where do I pay service fee for Recognition and Equivalence process? Where do I pay service fee for Recognition and Equivalence process? Due to intensive correspondence, communication and commission costs related to recognition and equivalence procedures, a fee is charged for the applications to be made to our Council as of 30 May 2016. Relevant fee is required to be deposited in the bank account with the information below. Payments to be made by hand are not accepted. “T.C. Ziraat Bankası A.Ş. / YÖK Denklik Banka Hesabı / IBAN: TR 4500 0100 1745 0538 6419 5057” Candidates who are foreign nationals and who have a YU number can make transaction from any bank on behalf of Ziraat Bank Ankara Kamu Girişimcilik Branch account. Foreign nationals who do not have a YU number can make transaction through Ankara Girişimcilik Şubesi (Söğütözü Mahallesi 2176 Cadde No: 7 06530 Çankaya Ankara) in person or through official representative.

- ##### How to apply for equivalence? How to apply for equivalence? The person or his deputy requesting an Equivalence Certificate or Graduation Recognition Certificate must apply online through the e-Government system. On the date of appointment, the documents must be submitted to the CoHE Recognition and Equivalence Department in order to activate the application.

- ##### Which institution performs Recognition and Equivalence operations? Which institution performs Recognition and Equivalence operations? Recognition and Equivalence operations are carried out by Department of Recognition and Equivalence Services affiliated to Council of Higher Education, which is a constitutional institution. This public service has started to be given in our organization since 1983.

- ##### In what cases can Institution/School recognition document be used? In what cases can Institution/School recognition document be used?
- For students who want to study abroad, to determine whether the institution they want to study is accepted as authorized to give academic degrees by Council of Higher Education.
- For use when switching from higher education institutions abroad to higher education institutions in Turkey.
- In order to provide information to institutions such as for health payments (SSI), Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Interior, Body of Lawyers, Governorates and Universities, depending on the request of the person who graduated from abroad.
- To make an application to the chairmanship of Interuniversity Board to obtain a doctorate degree from the higher education institutions abroad.
- For foreign nationals who have graduated from higher education institutions in Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus and want to use their diploma outside Turkey.
- For foreign students who will begin postgraduate education in Turkey, excluding health fields.

- ##### What is a Graduation Recognition Certificate? What is a Graduation Recognition Certificate? This document states that the holder is a graduate of a recognized higher education institution and program, and the equivalence of degree (pre-bachelor-master degree) in Turkey. However, it does not feature a Diploma Equivalence Certificate.

- ##### Where should I apply for recognition and equivalence? Where should I apply for recognition and equivalence? Application of Institution/School Recognition documents can be made via e-government. Applications made via e-government are exempt from the fee. In addition, applications to Council of Higher Education are accepted in person or by post, and a service fee is charged for these applications. After application of Diploma Equivalence Certificate is made through the e-Government gateway, originals of documents should be presented to the Department of Recognition and Equivalence of Council of Higher Education in Ankara on the appointment date given.

- ##### What is an Institution/School Recognition Certificate? What is an Institution/School Recognition Certificate? It is a document that indicates whether a higher education institution is recognized by the Higher Education Council but does not qualify as a Diploma Equivalence Certificate.

- ##### Is there a different application for nationals of countries with war, annexation and occupation? Is there a different application for nationals of countries with war, annexation and occupation? Applicants who are not able to present original documents or part of the documents during the application, due to the presence of war, occupation or annexed conditions in the country of education, or applicants who are not eligible for diploma confirmations, shall be included in the process of equivalence in accordance with the regulations made by Board Decision, in the event that they are limited to the period of war or disaster, and that no confirmation correspondence can be received.

- ##### In what cases is Equivalence Certificate rejected? In what cases is Equivalence Certificate rejected? If diploma is taken from a higher education institution which is not recognized by Council of Higher Education, if it is taken from programs other than distance education or if it is taken from programs graduated without fulfilling the requirements of formal education, if it is taken from programs with Turkish language (except for bilateral / multiple agreements), if equivalent of it is not found in the Turkish Higher Education System in terms of education program, field and degree and In case the education does not provide the necessary academic and professional achievements in terms of qualification, the application is REJECTED.

- ##### Can a diploma rejected for equivalence application be used in Turkey? Can a diploma rejected for equivalence application be used in Turkey? Approved or Rejected equivalence decision given by Council of Higher Education is an official / legally binding decision. Therefore, a diploma that does not have an equivalence certificate does not have an academic value; this means that it does not provide proficiency in the professional sense (provided that the arrangements made by the Vocational Chambers are also considered) and neither academically nor professionally cannot be used in Turkey.

- ##### Is it possible to apply again for a diploma that was previously rejected? Is it possible to apply again for a diploma that was previously rejected? By presenting new information and documents, the Diploma holder can appeal the old decision and apply for equivalence again. However, in case of rejection decision again, he/she has right to seek a judicial review.

- ##### Do the graduates of the TRNC universities need to apply for equivalence? Do the graduates of the TRNC universities need to apply for equivalence? Graduates of Turkish nationalities who are placed by ÖSYM in universities in TRNC do not need to apply for equivalence. Their diplomas are valid in Turkey. However, foreign nationals who graduated from TRNC, TRNC citizens and Turkish citizens who graduated from Master's and Special Talent Programmes must apply for equivalence. Those wishing to use TRNC Diploma in a foreign country can use their diplomas abroad by obtaining "Institution/School Recognition Certificate" from our board and making "Apostille”.

- ##### How to obtain a School Recognition Certificate? How to obtain a School Recognition Certificate? - ##### What should you know about residence permits? What should you know about residence permits? • Foreigners residing in our country with a residence permit must notify the relevant authorities of their address and marital status within 20 working days at the latest.
• The residence permit documents are issued annually with yearly determined residence permit fee and residence permit document fee. For detailed information you can visit www.goc.gov.tr.

- ##### Why is a residence permit necessary? Why is a residence permit necessary? • In Turkey, foreigners who will stay longer than visa/visa exemption period or 90 days will be required to obtain a residence permit.
• Foreigners requesting a residence permit must have a passport or a document equivalent to passport, which is 60 days longer than the period requested.

- ##### Where to apply for residence permit? Where to apply for residence permit? • It is essential that the applications of foreigners who will reside in our country are made from the Consulates in the country where they are citizens or legally located.
• However, in the process of establishing our overseas organization, the residence permit for foreigners residing in Turkey during the visa application is made within the country.
• In order to enable the first applications and, transition and extension applications to be made in electronic environment "e-residence" system, which can be accessed from www.goc.gov.tr , was developed. Here, applications are made electronically by foreigner and documents required for the type of referenced residence permit are reported in the application form.

- ##### How is the process of applying for a residence permit in general? How is the process of applying for a residence permit in general?

- ##### How should the student report status changes? How should the student report status changes? • The student must inform the Provincial Immigration Administration Directorate in the province where he/she is located within 20 days about his/her studentship status change provided that the students have not been given a break from school.
• In case of notification within 20 days, current residence permit remains valid.
• In case of University / Faculty change in the same city, student must report to the Provincial Immigration Administration Directorate within 20 days.

- ##### How to apply for e-residence extension? How to apply for e-residence extension? • If the foreigners who have a residence permit want to extend these permits, they should apply for extension of the residence permit from the e-residence system, and after the payment of residence permit fee and residence permit document fee, applicant should submit all requested documents together with the receipts to Provincial Immigration Directorate Administration Office within 5 working days via PTT registered post or cargo.
So briefly:
FILL IN APPLICATION FORM – PAY FEE – SEND DOCUMENTS BY MAIL

- ##### In what cases are the residence permits cancelled? In what cases are the residence permits cancelled? • Failure to fulfill one or more of the application requirements for residence permit
• Determining whether the residence permit is used for other than intended purpose
• Effective deportation decision or decision to ban entry to Turkey for relevant person

- ##### What is first e-residence application? What is first e-residence application? • In the first applications, the foreigner who made an appointment by completing the residence permit application form will be able to perform operations by going to Provincial Immigration Administration Directorate on the date and time of the appointment. Foreigner, whose application is accepted is granted “Residence Permit Application Certificate" by Provincial Immigration Administration Directorate.
• In this tab, foreigners are required to apply for one of the types of residence permit (short-term, family, student or long-term residence permit) from the first application screen before the expiry of their visa, residence permit or exemption period.
So briefly:
FILL APPLICATION FORM – COLLECT DOCUMENTS – COME ON APPOINTMENT DAY

- ##### In what cases are the residence permit applications cancelled? In what cases are the residence permit applications cancelled? • Those who do not have valid health insurance covering duration of stay
• Introduction to Turkey, the transition from Turkey or the purpose of the stay in Turkey to justify the reasons
• Those who do not have sufficient and regular financial means
• Those who do not agree to pay debts arising from visa infringement, prior residence permits, or debts to be collected in accordance with relevant Law, or those who do not agree to pay their fines and penalties pursuant to the Turkish Penal Code.

- ##### Should foreigners who come to our country under the exchange programs receive a residence permit? Should foreigners who come to our country under the exchange programs receive a residence permit? • Foreigners who will come for education or similar purposes within the framework of agreements or student exchange programs where Republic of Turkey is a party must obtain a short-term residence permit without paying fee.
• Students studying in Turkish Schools or Faculties are exempt from residence permit fee.

- ##### How are residence permits for Erasmus students arranged? How are residence permits for Erasmus students arranged? • Residence permits for students coming under Erasmus are held up to the period of exchange program without any fee.
• If the student needs to stay longer, he / she must apply for a residence permit extension.
• Extension application for the residence permit through e-Residence system should be made before the end of the period

- ##### How many days does the residence permit application result in How many days does the residence permit application result in • Applicant is given a residence permit application which allows him / her to stay legally in the country.
• The applications will be finalized within 90 days at the latest. If this time is extended, applicant is informed.

- ##### What are the types of residence permits? What are the types of residence permits? • "Short term residence permit"which is issued for 1 year or for 2 years periods.
• "Family Residence Permit"which is issued for a maximum period of three years at each time
• "Student Residence Permit” is issued according to the duration of the study
• "Long Term Residence Permit"is issued without time limit
• "Humanitarian Residence Permit” which is issued for a maximum period of one year
• "Human Trafficking Victim Residence Permit"which is given for 30 days at first and which can be extended for up to 6 months each time. Total duration will not exceed 3 years.

- ##### Which documents are required to apply for residence permit?
